description: Defines classes and functions for managing Oblivious HTTP header key configurations, including creation, parsing, serialization, and key management according to the OHTTP specification.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig
classes.description: Represents a single Oblivious HTTP header key configuration, including key ID, cryptographic scheme IDs, and related methods for serialization and parsing.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs
classes.description: Manages multiple Oblivious HTTP header key configurations and associated public keys, supporting creation, parsing, serialization, and key selection.

classes.name: SymmetricAlgorithmsConfig
classes.description: Defines a set of symmetric algorithms (kdf_id and aead_id) used in key configurations.

classes.name: OhttpKeyConfig
classes.description: Represents a key configuration including key ID, kem ID, public key, and supported symmetric algorithms.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: SerializeRecipientContextInfo
methods.description: Builds HPKE context info bytes for the recipient.

methods.name: ParseOhttpPayloadHeader
methods.description: Parses and verifies the Oblivious HTTP payload header from bytes or a data reader.

methods.name: ParseKeyIdFromObliviousHttpRequestPayload
methods.description: Extracts the key ID from an Oblivious HTTP request payload.

methods.name: SerializeOhttpPayloadHeader
methods.description: Serializes the header into a byte string for transmission.

methods.name: GenerateConcatenatedKeys
methods.description: Generates a byte string of all configured keys in the 'application/ohttp-keys' format.

methods.name: PreferredConfig
methods.description: Returns the key configuration with the highest key ID.

methods.name: GetPublicKeyForId
methods.description: Retrieves the public key associated with a given key ID.

methods.name: ParseConcatenatedKeys
methods.description: Parses a byte string of concatenated keys into an ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs object.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs object from a set of key configurations.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an ObliviousHttpKeyConfigs object from a single key configuration and public key.
